description: Reads the open model the way the Bridge Thermal Loads plugin does: the deck from a structure group, element list or the CIVIL NX selection, grouped into sections (beams by section, plates by thickness), each with the proposed deck type, depths h and D, and its width-against-depth parts per material (read through the shared section library; catalogue sections from CIVIL NX's published properties). Also the units, the initial temperature and any EC1T_ cases already in the model. Read-only.

group.description: Structure group holding the deck elements.

useSelection.description: Use the elements selected in CIVIL NX (when neither group nor elementIds is given).

name: bridge_thermal_read
title: Read the deck sections for thermal loads
